content.comment_body: I'm working with a [product_name] device and trying to connect it using [product_name] [version_no] demo software, but I keep encountering an error. I've tried updating, yet the same issue persists.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing trouble connecting a [product_name] hardware device to [product_name] [version_no] demo software due to an unspecified error. Troubleshooting is hindered because the error message cannot be viewed. Uncertainty about software version compatibility and lack of clear error messages are the main issues impacting the user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable communication between their hardware and software, straightforward troubleshooting, and clear, visible error messages as well as ensured compatibility.
